entities.name: Vidosav Stevanović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vidosav Stevanović is a Serbian novelist, writer, poet, playwright, and publicist. He has written over thirty literary works, including a political biography of Slobodan Milošević. Stevanović was a writer for European newspapers such as Le Monde, Liberation, El País and Expressen.
